 Squads for men’s A-League game between Auckland FC and Melbourne Victory
 posted in: A-League (Men) , News , Uncategorized 
 | 
 Former Auckland FC striker Guillermo May is set for a reunion with his old teammates after being named in Melbourne Victory’s squad for Saturday’s men’s A-League clash. 
 The Uruguayan forward returns from injury and is among 20 players named by Victory in their matchday squad.
 May (28) returns from a groin strain that kept him out of Victory’s 2-2 draw with Adelaide United, having started their previous three league matches.
 The striker left Auckland during the off-season to join Melbourne Victory.
 Meanwhile, head coach Pedro Moreira has named a strong squad for the fixture, with no new injuries.

 In: 45. Matthew D’Hotman, 46. James Mitchell.
 Out: 24. Aaron Cartwright, 25. Luka Vicelich (injured).
 Unavailable: 7. Cameron Howieson (calf), 19. Oliver Middleton (knee), 28. Aaron Calver (ankle).
 Melbourne Victory (two to be omitted)
 1. Jack Warshawsky, 3. Jason Davidson, 5. Brendan Hamill, 6. Louis D’Arrigo, 8. Jordi Valadon, 9. Harrison Sawyer, 10. Denis Genreau, 11. Clerismario Santos Rodrigues, 14. Matthew Grimaldi, 15. Thomas Lockyer, 18. Franco Lino, 19. Oliver Dragicevic, 21. Guillermo May, 22. Xavier Stella, 23. Keegan Jelacic, 25. Jack Duncan, 26. Jack Mihailidis, 29. Michael Ghossaini, 36. Harrison Shillington, 44. Charles Nduka.
 In: 21. Guillermo May (returning from injury), 36. Harrison Shillington (returning from suspension).
 Out: None.
 Unavailable: 4. Philipp Ziereis (suspended), 16. Joshua Inserra (injury).
